findings.title: Broken Legal Center shortcut route pointing to /phase-3/legal (404)
findings.observedBehaviour: The Venture Hub shortcut button for 'Legal Center' rendered <Link href="/dashboard/creator/phase-3/legal">, which led to a 404 Route Not Found page.
findings.resolution: Updated shortcut in src/app/dashboard/creator/page.tsx to use projectHref('/dashboard/creator/phase-3/compliance').
findings.evidence: src/app/dashboard/creator/phase-3/compliance/page.tsx verified as canonical route; vitest and unit tests confirm resolution.
findings.userImpact: Resolved. Creators navigate directly to Legal & Compliance workspace with active project context.

findings.title: Backend summary generates invalid /phase-4/construction-snapshot route for Phase 4.1
findings.observedBehaviour: CreatorDashboardService generated hrefs pointing to /dashboard/creator/phase-4/construction-snapshot for NextAction, Attention Items, Substages, and Results.
findings.resolution: Updated all Phase 4.1 hrefs in CreatorDashboardService.cs to return /dashboard/creator/phase-4 with project context.
findings.evidence: CreatorDashboardSummaryTests.cs and CreatorDashboardService.cs updated; tests confirm canonical route /dashboard/creator/phase-4.
findings.userImpact: Resolved. All Phase 4.1 CTAs and substage links resolve to the canonical Construction Snapshot page.

findings.title: Dashboard service models Phase 4 with 7 steps, omitting Phase 4.8 and 4.9
findings.observedBehaviour: BuildJourneyOverview hardcoded TotalSteps = 7 for Phase 4, omitting 4.8 Launch Assets and 4.9 Construction Readiness. ResolveNextAction jumped straight from 4.7 GTM to Phase 5 Crossroads, and BuildResultsList omitted 4.8/4.9 outputs.
findings.resolution: Extended Phase4CompletionResolver, CreatorJourneyService, and CreatorDashboardService (BuildJourneyOverview, ResolveNextAction, ResolveAttentionItems, BuildResultsList, and BuildPhase5Summary) to evaluate and sequence all 9 canonical Phase 4 steps.
findings.evidence: All 49 backend unit tests and 30 Vitest tests pass, verifying 9 substages, Step 4.8 launch assets next action, Step 4.9 readiness next action, and saved outputs for Launch Website and Readiness Review.
findings.userImpact: Resolved. Founders sequence through Launch Assets (4.8) and Construction Readiness Review (4.9) before unlocking Phase 5 Crossroads.

findings.title: Missing activeIdeaId query parameter on static dashboard buttons and backend substage hrefs
findings.observedBehaviour: Static dashboard buttons and backend-returned substage and result hrefs lacked the ?ideaId={activeIdeaId} parameter.
findings.resolution: Added projectHref helper in page.tsx for project-scoped links and updated CreatorDashboardService to wrap all substages and results in Route(path, ideaId).
findings.userImpact: Resolved. Active project context is consistently preserved across navigation, tabs, and project switches.

findings.userImpact: No defect. Current alias behavior is verified as intentional and safe.
